first_breath.challengerIntro: A young man drops from the temple arch, landing light as a leaf. *Kaelen*. Reva's first student — and her strictest gate.
first_breath.challengerTaunt: "Reva teaches no one the wind hasn't tested. Show me you can be blown down and rise."

beats.text: The path narrows to a ledge of wind-carved stone. Far below, cloud-sea turns slowly against the cliffs. Prayer flags snap in a rhythm that feels almost like speech.
Two weathered pillars frame the temple gate. The air between them moves against the wind — in, and out, in, and out. Old discipline, older than the stones.
An open courtyard worn smooth by generations of footwork. Someone is already waiting for you.

first_dawn.challengerIntro: He has been standing in the same sunbeam since before you arrived. *Orrin*, Iyra's dawn-warden, shadowless at this hour.
first_dawn.challengerTaunt: "The sun burns away everything that hesitates. Do you hesitate?"

beats.text: White steps climb out of the morning mist, each one warm to the touch. somewhere above, a bell marks the first hour.
An open circle of pale stone where no shadow falls wrong. The dawn light pools here like water. A figure waits at its center.

tides_of_sanctuary.challengerIntro: She rises out of the reflecting pool without disturbing a single ripple. *Maru*, Solen's tide-daughter.
tides_of_sanctuary.challengerTaunt: "Water yields to everything, and is defeated by nothing. Push me, and learn what pushes back."

beats.text: Columns stand knee-deep in water so clear it looks like air. Koi drift between the stones, unbothered by your weight on the path.
The pool holds the sky perfectly still. Your reflection arrives a half-second late — as if deciding whether to follow.

oath_of_iron.challengerIntro: The iron yard goes quiet. *Brakk* — Vance's breaker, a wall of scar and gristle — sets down his hammer and cracks his knuckles one by one.
oath_of_iron.challengerTaunt: "The Order doesn't spar. It stamps. Show me the metal in you or get stamped out."

beats.text: Anvils in rows, hammers in racks, and the ringing of metal so constant it becomes silence. Every surface bears dents in patterns too regular to be accidents.
A circle of packed earth ringed by broken weapons planted like grave-markers. The Order's acceptance rate is written on the ground.

void_initiation.challengerIntro: The rift-gate light bends around a silhouette that doesn't quite match its shadow. *Nhal*, Kael's first cutting.
void_initiation.challengerTaunt: "I have been unmade once already. What will you take from me that I haven't lost?"

beats.text: The gate isn't a door. It's a place where the world forgot to finish. Colors bleed at the edges and sound arrives before its cause.
Beyond the gate, terrain gives up pretending. Floating shards of landscape orbit a silence that has weight.

rite_of_embers.challengerIntro: She speaks and the brazier answers in the same rhythm. *Dara*, Phlox's ash-voice, first of the ember-tongued.
rite_of_embers.challengerTaunt: "Fire doesn't test what you can take. It tests what you can carry while burning. Hold out your hands."

beats.text: Statues crowd the path — older ones weathered smooth, newer ones still holding expressions. None of them are stone.
The low brazier burns without fuel. Phlox kneels beside it and does not look up. The fire looks at you instead.

vow_of_the_shield.challengerIntro: The shield wall doesn't part — a hatch in it opens and a woman steps through, armored in layered plates that lock as she moves. *Tessera*, Aspis's wall-maker.
vow_of_the_shield.challengerTaunt: "Anyone can hit. Show me you can HOLD. Break my line, or be broken on it."

beats.text: Where the Sanctuary meets the road, shield-bearing pilgrims drill in silence. Their steps fall in unison — one sound, many feet.
Aspis stands at the center of a formation that has not moved in hours. He nods once. The wall opens like a gate deciding to be a door.

covenant_of_caligo.challengerIntro: It has your silhouette. *The Unlit*, Caligo's shadow-given-form — the covenant's toll, walking ahead of you.
covenant_of_caligo.challengerTaunt: "Every light casts me. Every step feeds me. Turn around — I am always one step behind."

beats.text: Light dims here without any source to dim. Your own shadow stops matching your movements — stretching, tasting the ground.
Darkness like a held page: flat, patient, full of writing you can almost read. Caligo waits where the ink is deepest.

starlit_passage.challengerIntro: She sits at a desk in the open field, charting skies that aren't overhead anymore. *The Cartographer*, Selene's map of everything that moves.
starlit_passage.challengerTaunt: "I have charted every road the stars take. You are a dot considering a line. Show me your trajectory."

beats.text: Grass silvered by light with no moon attached. The constellations overhead are rearranging — politely, like furniture being moved for a guest.
A single upright stone at the field's center, shadow pointing not down but along a line only Selene's students can see.

the_mercy_rising.challengerIntro: He is bandaged from crown to boot and stands as if pain were a language he stopped speaking. *The Convalescent*, Eleos's first risen.
the_mercy_rising.challengerTaunt: "I have died politely, once. What you do to me now, I will outlive. Come — the mercy needs practice."

beats.text: Cots in rows, each perfectly made and empty. The air smells of clean linen and the particular silence of places that have seen too much and chosen gentleness anyway.
Twelve steps of white stone. Each has a name carved on its riser. Eleos waits at the top, and does not offer a hand — you must rise on your own.

the_thunder_road.challengerIntro: He's shaking before you finish nodding — not fear, voltage. *Syx*, Kestrel's bolt-runner, first down the thunder road and still humming from it.
the_thunder_road.challengerTaunt: "Storms don't warn, they RSVP. Try to keep up — the road eats the slow."

beats.text: A picket line of grounded rods hums at the edge of the expanse. Past it, clouds move like they have somewhere to be and no intention of waiting.
The thunder road is not a road until you run it. Beneath your feet the ground holds a charge like a held breath.

the_winter_oath.challengerIntro: Frost blooms outward from her footprints — she has been standing here long enough to become a season. *Sorrel*, Yrsa's rimekeeper.
the_winter_oath.challengerTaunt: "Winter does not hate what it freezes. It keeps. Show me you are worth keeping."

beats.text: Two ice formations like open hands frame the pass. The cold here is precise — it takes exactly what it reaches for.
Everything past the gate is preserved mid-motion: a bird, a falling leaf, a running deer. Winter keeps what it loves, and it loves everything.

the_poisoned_garden.challengerIntro: The garden sings first — then something in the trellis unfolds into a figure wearing petals like armor. *Nightbloom*, Solenne's first flowering.
the_poisoned_garden.challengerTaunt: "Everything in this garden is beautiful and lethal. I am the most beautiful. Sing with me and find out why."

beats.text: The perfume arrives before the gate does — honey and rot in perfect balance. Your feet want to walk faster; the garden wants you slow.
Every bloom here is a diplomacy of toxin: beauty as a warning label. Solenne waters the beds and does not look up. Nightbloom rises from the trellis instead.

the_moonless_road.challengerIntro: You hear the song before you see the singer — and the singer is a shape the moonlight refuses. *The Hollow Chorister*, Morwen's first veil.
the_moonless_road.challengerTaunt: "The moonless road eats names. Mine is long gone — sing yours, and I will hold it for you. Forever, probably."

beats.text: No moon was scheduled tonight, and yet the road is silvered — lit by something that left. Your footsteps sound an instant after you take them.
Signposts point in directions that don't exist yet. Morwen stands where all the arrows agree, and beside her, something sings without a mouth.

the_keepers_hour.challengerIntro: She is already turning away when you arrive — she's been done with this conversation for an hour and is waiting for you to catch up. *Mae*, Chronis's second hand.
the_keepers_hour.challengerTaunt: "I have already fought you. You lost, then you trained, then you came back. Let's not waste the interval — fight me now."

beats.text: Every wall has a bracket for a clock and every bracket is empty. Time here is kept by something older than mechanisms — you can feel it counting.
A single hourglass the size of a doorway. The sand falls upward. Chronis sits beside it, patient as a museum, and gestures you through.
